== Description ==
'''E-10i''' is one of the many entities you may encounter within [[Section E]], it being the i variant of [[E-10]], acting the same but faster and having the ability to teleport.

== Behaviour ==
'''E-10i''' will spawn in front of the main room exit door and begin to run back after idling for roughly three seconds. The entity will then wait behind the Voidwall until the next door is opened or broken down. 

When this action occurs, '''E-10i''' will rush back to the main room and break down the door. However, compared to the [[E-10|original counterpart]], '''E-10i''' will teleport after a few seconds, waiting for another door to be opened or broken. '''E-10i''' will repeat this process around one to four times before disappearing, colliding with the door, which could potentially lead to another entity spawning.

==Strategy & Tips==
* It is recommended to hide right after it spawned, as it will only give you 1-2 seconds to react.
** Think about what locker you're about to use though, since you might end up dying to [[E-45]].
* If a door gets opened/broken, hide immediately as '''E-10i''' is faster than the [[E-10|normal counterpart]].
* '''E-10i''' may cause or partake in a certain chain of events, like '''it''' and [[E-60]] together.
** [[E-60]] rushes through first, breaking the door and causing '''E-10i''' to rush through. '''E-10i''' will come through to break the door whilst [[E-60]] rushes back.

==Trivia==
* '''E-10i''' could invade during [[Perfection Event 2/13/26]] and [[Perfection Event 3/13/26]].
** This however was probably not seen by anyone, as his chance to spawn was 1 in 6 million.

==Lore==
* '''E-10i''' is the result of a failed shadow infection.
